name: search_flights
description: Search one-way flight offers via the Duffel sandbox API. Present the returned offers to the traveler to choose from.

origin.description: Origin airport IATA code (3 letters, e.g. "JFK").

destination.description: Destination airport IATA code (3 letters, e.g. "MIA").

name: get_weather
description: Get the daily weather forecast for a city on a given date, using the Open-Meteo API. Use this to advise on what to pack.

target_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, within the next ~16 days.

name: book_flight
description: Book a chosen flight offer for a named passenger. Records the booking in the FlightBookings DynamoDB table. Call only after search_flights and once the traveler has chosen an offer.

offer_id.description: The offer_id of the chosen flight (from search_flights).

amount.description: The offer's total_amount (from the chosen offer).
